class.name: BulletSpawner2D
class.brief_description: Fires timed volleys of directional bullets through a [BulletFactory2D].
class.description: Assign a [BulletFactory2D], a [DirectionalBulletsData2D], and a [member pattern_source]. Each volley collects one global transform per bullet from the [member transforms_generator] (empty means this node; a generator outside the tree while the spawner is inside also falls back to this node) and spawns it through the factory. It never fires in the editor. Homing quick-start: turn on [member homing_enabled], leave [member homing_target_source] on Node Group, and put your targets (any Node2D) in the [member homing_node_group] group (default "enemies"). Every volley then chases [member homing_target_selection] targets with [member homing_smoothing] turn rate. Set [member homing_target_source] to Mouse to chase the cursor instead, and turn on [member orbiting_enabled] to make bullets ring their target once they arrive. Use [member homing_retarget_mode] so flying volleys keep following fresh targets, and [signal volley_bullet_homing_target_reached] to react when a bullet arrives. Pattern quick-start: pick a [member pattern_source] helper (Ring, Fan, Spiral, Rose, Corridor...) or call [method apply_pattern_preset] for a starter, tune the matching helper_* group, and call [method shoot_once] (or enable [member shooting_enabled] for the auto loop). Add [member pattern_scale] / spin for motion, [member helper_skip_indices] for dodge doors, and [method spawn_pattern_list] for phased sequences. See [member pattern_source] for the full 33-mode list.

method.name: adopt_live_volley
method.description: Takes ownership of a manually-woken volley (manual wake detaches the previous owner): stamps it, replaces the previous spawner's reached forwarder with its own, and tracks it for retargeting. Queues are left alone. Handlers you connected directly on the volley are kept; only spawner forwarders are replaced. Returns false for null or non-live instances.

method.name: apply_pattern_preset
method.description: Fills the helper_* properties with a named starter pattern (radial dense/sparse, 3-arm spiral, narrow/wide aimed fan, slow ring, gap wall, rain, 6-petal flower, scatter burst, cross burst, star shell, heart bloom, snake wave, waterfall curtain, petal storm via Rose, twin counter-spiral via Counter Spiral, aimed trap via Corridor, blossom finale via Rose, terrain crest via Edge) and switches pattern_source to match. Tunes from there; the preset only writes the properties, nothing fires. Custom (-1) does nothing. Note: the twin counter-spiral preset also turns spin on at -60 deg/sec and the blossom finale preset turns spin on at +30 deg/sec.

method.name: begin_burst
method.description: Starts a burst chain by hand (waves and boss phases driving phrasing on timers instead of the auto loop). Clears any pending telegraph first. The chain then fires through [method fire_burst_volley] on the burst interval.

method.name: begin_telegraph
method.description: Starts a telegraph warning by hand: emits volley_telegraphed with a snapshot of the current aim, then fires after telegraph_sec. The actual fire re-collects transforms, so markers that move during the warning still aim correctly.

method.name: clear_live_volleys
method.description: Forgets all tracked volleys. They keep flying untouched and are no longer retargeted. Reached-signal forwarding stays connected. Tracking is also capped at the 256 most recent volleys (oldest dropped first), so long auto-shoot sessions with infinite lifetimes cannot grow retarget cost without bound.

method.name: clear_live_volleys_homing
method.description: Kill-switch: clears homing queues and stops orbiting on every tracked live volley, through engine clears that keep all counters exact. Returns how many volleys were touched. Retargeting re-arms them while homing stays on; turn homing off (or clear tracking) to keep them flying straight.

method.name: collect_spawn_transforms
method.description: Returns one global transform per bullet for the current [member pattern_source]. Empty [member transforms_generator] means this node. Children mode with no markers falls back to the generator itself. Aimed mode with no target returns an empty array. Corridor mode with no target falls back to [member helper_corridor_aim_direction] so the wall still draws. Corridor and Ellipse Wall modes return fewer transforms than [member helper_bullets_amount] (the carved gaps shrink the array).

method.name: fire_burst_volley
method.description: Fires the next volley of the active burst/telegraph chain (auto loop calls this; manual drivers call it on their own timers). Alternate-mirror bursts flip chirality on even shots. Manual shoot_once stays legal any time: a chain never blocks it, the chain only owns the shots it fires itself.

method.name: fire_n_volleys
method.description: Arms a one-shot budget of n more volleys, then pauses. Counts every fired volley (auto or manual). [member max_volleys] is never touched, so unlimited stays unlimited. Replaces any previous budget; unpauses a paused spawner. Rejected when n is not above zero. Armed while disabled too: volleys fire once re-enabled. See [method volleys_remaining].

method.name: get_active_live_bullet_count
method.description: Total live bullets across ALL volleys owned by this spawner (counted via the factory by ownership - plain non-homing volleys count exactly like tracked homing volleys). Budget governors and wave gates read this alongside max_live_bullets.

method.name: get_bullet_factory
method.description: Returns the factory from [member bullet_factory_path], or null when unset or invalid.

method.name: get_burst_shots_left
method.description: Shots left in the current burst chain (0 when idle). Waves and HUD can poll this to sequence phases.

method.name: get_effective_generator
method.description: Returns the node patterns are built on: the assigned generator, or this spawner when unset or invalid. Never null in the tree.

method.name: get_helper_aimed_target
method.description: Returns the shared aimed target (Aimed cone and Corridor wall), or null when unset.

method.name: get_live_volley_count
method.description: How many spawned volleys are currently tracked for retargeting.

method.name: debug_check_layer_coincidence
method.description: Verifies every layered preview dot sits on its yellow ring (same center-scale rule and same fill deal on both sides). Returns checked/layers/max_deviation_px/mean_deviation_px/ok. Empty preview returns checked=false. Point-to-segment match: exact on sharp shapes, sub-pixel on dense sweeps.

method.name: debug_get_layer_rings
method.description: Debug readout of the yellow preview rings: one PackedVector2Array per extra outline layer, exactly as drawn (holder-local; runs INF-separated with a closing duplicate per closed run). Empty when layers are inactive. Lets scripts and tests verify bullets sit on their rings without screenshotting the editor.

method.name: get_live_volleys
method.description: The tracked live volley instances (pruned first), so scripts can call the full DirectionalBullets2D API on each volley directly. Inspect-only handles: a volley can be pooled and reused for a new owner while you still hold it, so always check [method DirectionalBullets2D.is_bullet_status_enabled] and ownership before steering a held volley. Use [method adopt_live_volley] to take ownership of a manually-woken volley.

method.name: get_pooled_volley_count
method.description: How many directional volleys sit ready in the factory pool. Warm-up checks and pool sizing read this (0 with no factory assigned).

method.name: get_spin_angle_deg
method.description: Current spin angle in degrees. Only advances at runtime while [member spin_enabled] is on.

method.name: get_transforms_generator
method.description: Returns the assigned generator, or null when unset. Use [method get_effective_generator] when you need the fallback included.

method.name: get_volleys_fired
method.description: Volleys fired since the last (re)arm. Reset with [method reset_shooting].

method.name: is_pattern_list_active
method.description: Whether a pattern list is currently queued/firing.

method.name: is_shooting_active
method.description: Effective shooting state: switch on, not paused, cap not reached. This is configured state (true outside the tree too), not whether a tick is imminent.

method.name: is_shooting_paused
method.description: Whether [method pause_shooting] is latched. While set, no volley is created (burst, telegraph, pattern-list and timer chains freeze); spin, retargeting and preview keep running.

method.name: is_spinning
method.description: Returns true when [member spin_enabled] is on and the game is running.

method.name: next_shoot_interval_sec
method.description: Next auto-shot interval with reload jitter applied (shoot_interval_sec +/- jitter, seeded by reload_jitter_seed). Poll for HUD reload bars.

method.name: override_live_volleys_velocity
method.description: Overwrites velocity on every tracked live volley (wind, knockback). A speed curve overrides direct velocity, so this visibly works only for curve-free volleys. Returns how many volleys were touched. Must be finite.

method.name: pause_shooting
method.description: Freezes volley creation keeping all counters: burst, telegraph, pattern-list and timer chains hold where they are and resume on [method resume_shooting]. Spin, retargeting and preview are unaffected. Manual [method shoot_once] and [method fire_burst_volley] still fire. Emits [signal shooting_stopped] on the active-to-idle transition.

method.name: reset_shooting
method.description: Resets the volley counter, clears pause and any [method fire_n_volleys] budget, clears burst/telegraph chains and the pattern-list queue, re-arms the timer with [member shoot_initial_delay_sec] (plus the retarget phase), and emits [signal shooting_started] when auto-shooting resumes.

method.name: reset_spin_angle
method.description: Resets the spin angle to zero.

method.name: resolve_homing_targets
method.description: Resolves the current homing targets without touching any volley: group members, name matches (case-insensitive unless [member homing_node_name_case_sensitive]), children of the parent path, the node at [member homing_target_path], or the [member homing_global_position] snapshot. The Mouse source returns an empty array (the cursor is pushed live, not resolved). Entries are Node2D or Vector2. Unless quiet is true, an empty result warns once until a resolution succeeds again. With advance_round_robin off, the round-robin pick is resolved without consuming the cursor (retarget passes use this so flying volleys keep stable targets).

method.name: resume_shooting
method.description: Clears [method pause_shooting]: frozen chains continue where they held. Emits [signal shooting_started] on the idle-to-active transition.

method.name: retarget_live_volleys
method.description: Re-resolves targets and replaces the queues of every still-active volley owned by this spawner (expired or pooled volleys are skipped), and re-applies steering and orbiting tuning so runtime changes reach flying volleys. Random and round-robin selections resolve per volley. Volleys with no resolvable targets are skipped quietly and keep their old queues. Volleys whose bullets are all disabled are skipped too: the tick never moves disabled slots, so pushing targets there would only inflate counters. Returns how many volleys were retargeted. Also runs automatically when [member homing_retarget_mode] is On Interval. Only the newest volley is touched when [member homing_retarget_previous_volleys] is off. Locked orbit rings survive the replace per the lock policy ([member orbiting_lock_policy]) instead of always re-locking.

method.name: set_bullet_factory
method.description: Assigns the factory directly. Pass null to clear it.

method.name: set_helper_aimed_target
method.description: Assigns the shared aimed target (Aimed cone and Corridor wall) directly. Pass null to clear it.

method.name: set_transforms_generator
method.description: Assigns the generator directly. Pass null to use this spawner instead. Takes effect right away, in the editor and at runtime.

method.name: shoot_once
method.description: Fires one volley now. Returns false when misconfigured or the factory refuses it. Counts toward [member max_volleys] and any [method fire_n_volleys] budget. Safe to call from _physics_process (same-shape pool reuse applies immediately; only a shape-type change waits for a safe point). Must not be called re-entrantly from inside spawner signal handlers (pre_shoot, homing_targets_resolved, volley_homing_configured, volley_fired, volley_skipped, shooting_finished): nested calls are rejected, use [method shoot_once_deferred] (or call_deferred("shoot_once")) instead. This also means intentional synchronous cascades (a handler firing another spawner immediately) are deferred by one frame by design. If a handler frees or re-homes the volley mid-setup (including pre_shoot, which is validated before configuring), the shot is safely dropped (returns false) instead of emitting volley_fired with a dead instance.

method.name: shoot_once_deferred
method.description: Queues a [method shoot_once] with call_deferred so it runs after the current emission / physics step instead of nesting. Use this from spawner signal handlers or colliding contexts. Returns false when the spawner is not inside the tree.

method.name: spawn_pattern_list
method.description: Queues pattern entries: each entry is a Dictionary with optional "preset", "pattern_source", "helper_bullets_amount", "spawn_data" keys. Sequential mode (default) fires one entry per interval_sec through the guarded shoot path; simultaneous mode fires all at once. Returns entries queued (sequential) or volleys fired (simultaneous). Bad entries skip with an error, never abort the list. Sequential mode emits [signal pattern_list_finished] when the queue drains; simultaneous mode does not (it returns the fired count directly).

method.name: start_spinning
method.description: Turns [member spin_enabled] on.

method.name: stop_pattern_list
method.description: Cancels the active pattern list (queued entries are dropped, fired volleys keep flying).

method.name: stop_spinning
method.description: Turns [member spin_enabled] off, freezing the angle.

method.name: volleys_remaining
method.description: Volleys left before [member max_volleys] trips or the [method fire_n_volleys] budget runs out, whichever is smaller. -1 means infinite (no cap, no budget).

members.member: Mirrors DirectionalBulletsData2D adjust_direction_based_on_rotation per volley: bullet directions follow their rotation data. Applied with the steering block while homing is on.
Path to the [BulletFactory2D] used for spawning.
Mirror every other burst volley (fan/spiral chirality flip): even burst shots fire mirrored, odd shots plain.
Shots per burst trigger. Must be 1 or more.
Fire multi-volley bursts per trigger: each interval pulls the trigger for burst_count shots spaced burst_interval_sec apart. Mid-burst shots ignore the main interval.
Seconds between burst shots. Must be finite and above zero.
Center the cone on the target. Off starts it to one side.

Blend toward the predicted target position: 0 aims at where the target is now, 1 fully leads it by helper_aimed_prediction_time at its current velocity (needs get_velocity on the target, else aims live).
Seconds of travel to lead the target by at full helper_aimed_prediction.
Aimed cone width in radians.
Spacing between aimed origins so bullets do not stack.
Node the aimed cone points at (also steers the Corridor wall when one is assigned). No target means no bullets in Aimed mode; Corridor falls back to helper_corridor_aim_direction.

Bullet count for helper patterns. Clamped to 1-10000: one volley fans out to transforms, instance buffers and physics shapes, so uncapped values would freeze on a typo. Outline Fill Inside may return fewer (small shapes run out of grid cells, like Corridor/Ellipse Wall gaps).
Circle bullets face outward (away from the generator); off faces inward (toward it).
Extra facing twist in degrees on top of the circle normal. Must be finite.
Exact circle loop radius in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Fallback aim axis (need not be normalized). The live aimed target wins when one is assigned. Must be finite and non-zero.
Face every slot down the aim axis. Off faces each slot away from the marker instead.
Extra facing twist in degrees. Must be finite.
Carved center dodge door in pixels. The output shrinks to the surviving slots (like Ellipse Wall). Must be finite, 0 or more, and narrower than the width.
Wall width in pixels across the aim axis. Must be finite, 0 or more, and wider than the gap.
Angle growth per step along each arm in radians (odd arms wind the opposite way when mirrored). Must be finite.
1 interleaves consecutive slots across arms, higher values group slots per arm. Must be 1 or more.
Counter-rotating arms. Must be 2 or more (use Multi Spiral for 1 arm).
Per-arm facing: tangent (travel direction), radial outward, toward center, or keep marker.
Twists every arm facing. Must be finite.
Mirror every other arm so neighbours counter-rotate (galaxy/windmill). Off winds all arms the same way like Multi Spiral.
Radius growth per step along each arm. Must be finite.
Rotate the arm phases with the marker. Off aims arms in global space.
First-slot radius in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Rays in the cross/plus barrage. Must be 1 or more.
How far each ray reaches from the marker. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Base rotation of the cross in radians.
Whether slots face away from the marker along their ray.
Extra facing twist in degrees.
Spacing between slots along each ray. Must be finite and above zero.

Which direction Custom bullets face: As Stored keeps each transform's rotation, Face Outward/Inward aims radially from the generator, +90/-90 Degrees turn the stored rotation across it. helper_custom_facing_offset_deg still applies on top.
Extra facing twist in degrees on top of the Custom facing. Must be finite.
Mirrors the Custom array order: bullet 0 moves to the far end.
Rotates which Custom array slot becomes bullet 0 (wraps both ways).

Hand-placed volley in generator-local pixels: each stored transform spawns exactly one bullet there (composed as marker * local, so spin and scales keep working). Empty by default (Custom draws nothing until you fill it). Every entry must be finite. The count comes from the array itself; helper_bullets_amount is ignored. Apply TERRAIN_CREST once for a starter crest line.
Diamond horizontal diagonal in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Diamond vertical diagonal in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Diamond bullets face outward; off faces inward.
Extra facing twist in degrees on top of the diamond normal. Must be finite.
Diamond base rotation in radians. Must be finite.
Arc span for Arc/Wall modes (full turn draws the whole ellipse). Must be finite.
Face along the ellipse outward normal. Off faces inward.
Twists every ellipse facing. Must be finite.
Dodge gaps carved into Wall mode. Shown only in Wall mode. Must be 0 or more.
Width of each Wall gap in radians. Shown only in Wall mode. Must be finite and 0 or more.
0 draws the full ring, 1 draws an arc segment, 2 draws a dense wall with carved dodge gaps. Wall mode with gap_count 0 or gap_width 0 draws the plain arc (no carving).
Ellipse semi-axis X in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Ellipse semi-axis Y in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Rotates the ellipse axes. Must be finite.
Where Arc/Wall segments start. Must be finite.
Per-slot random angle variance in radians for shotgun spreads. 0 fires the exact cone. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Seed for fan angle jitter only. 0 is non-deterministic, otherwise every volley lands identically. Does nothing while [member helper_fan_angle_jitter] is 0. Only shown for the Fan pattern.
Center the fan on its direction. Off starts it to one side.
Fan center direction in radians.
Fan width in radians.
Spacing between fan origins so bullets do not stack.
Rotates the whole flower. Must be finite.
Slots per lobe. Must be 1 or more.
Face away from the marker. Off faces the marker (implosion blossoms).
Twists every flower facing. Must be finite.
Core-hole lift for RHODONEA, PHYLLOTAXIS, SUPERFORMULA: 0 is a full bloom, closer to 1 lifts the waist into a ring. Must be finite in [0, 1).
Pinch between lobes: 0 is round, higher is tighter. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Angular width of each lobe in radians. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Lobes in the flower pattern. Must be 1 or more.
Flower radius in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
SPIROGRAPH only: hypotrochoid pen offset d (>= 0). Larger values stretch the loops outward.
SPIROGRAPH only: hypotrochoid roller radius r (> 0). Larger values pull the lacy loops tighter.
SUPERFORMULA only: fullness exponent controlling round vs. pinched petal shape. Must be finite in (0, 8].
SUPERFORMULA only: lobe count m of the simplified Gielis curve. Must be finite in [2, 64].
Bloom kind selector (see [enum BulletFactory2D.FlowerBloom]): FAN (legacy default), RHODONEA, PHYLLOTAXIS, SPIROGRAPH, SUPERFORMULA. Per-type knobs below apply only to their matching bloom kind.
Grid anchor, same values as [enum BulletFactory2D.Alignment].
Grid horizontal spacing.
Random position offset per grid bullet. 0 is off.

Seed for grid jitter and random rotation only. 0 is non-deterministic, otherwise every volley lands identically. Does nothing while [member helper_grid_jitter] is 0 and random rotation is off. Only shown for the Grid pattern.
Give each grid bullet a random facing.
Rotate the grid with the generator.
Grid vertical spacing.
Grid rows per column.
Base rotation of the heart in radians.
Whether slots face away from the heart center.
Extra facing twist in degrees.
Heart outline size in pixels. Must be finite and above zero.
Honeycomb columns. Must be 1 or more.
Whether slots face away from the marker.
Extra facing twist in degrees.
Honeycomb rows. Must be 1 or more.
Horizontal spacing in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Vertical spacing in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Offset odd rows by half spacing for the honeycomb look.
Where the generator sits on the line, same values as [enum BulletFactory2D.LineAnchor].
Line axis. Does not need to be normalized.
Face line bullets along the line. Off keeps the generator facing.

Which direction line bullets face: along the line (as generated: axis or marker per helper_line_face_direction), or turned +90/-90 degrees across it. The per-line facing_offset_deg still applies on top. Replaces the old perpendicular toggle.
Mirrors the line row order: bullet 0 moves to the far end.
Rotates which line slot becomes bullet 0 (wraps both ways).
Distance between line bullets.
Shifts the whole line row along its axis in pixels, on top of the Start/Center/End anchor. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Face away from the curve center. Off faces inward.
Extra facing twist in degrees. Must be finite.
Horizontal weave frequency. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Vertical weave frequency. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Phase offset in radians (morphs the figure-8 into its weave variants). Must be finite.
Weave half-width in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Weave half-height in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Angle growth per step along each arm. Must be finite.
1 interleaves consecutive slots across arms, higher values group slots per arm. Must be 1 or more.
Interleaved spiral arms. Must be 1 or more.
Per-arm facing: tangent (travel direction), radial outward, toward center, or keep marker.
Twists every arm facing. Must be finite.
Radius growth per step along each arm. Must be finite.
Rotate the arm phases with the marker. Off aims arms in global space.
First-slot radius in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Rotates each closed-loop shape facing: Outline Normal keeps it as generated, +90/-90 Degrees turn it toward the loop tangent. The per-shape facing_offset_deg still applies on top.
Keep-out distance in pixels from the loop edge for Fill Inside cells. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Interior grid cell size in pixels for Fill Inside (rows run top-down like the Grid helper). Must be finite and above zero.
Shifts every other Fill Inside row by half a cell (honeycomb packing).

Where closed-loop shape bullets live (Ring, Ellipse, Star, Flower, Rose, Lissajous, Circle, Rectangle, Square, Polygon, Triangle, Trapezoid, Diamond, Heart): On Outline keeps the generated slot loop exactly (single layer, the default), Layers re-spawns the same slot loop scaled about the loop center (layer 0 on the outline: the identical figure at a different size per layer), Fill Inside swaps it for a row-major grid masked to the loop interior.
Mirrors the closed-loop slot order (winding flip): bullet 0 moves to the far end of the loop. On-outline and layers layouts only.
How many concentric rings share the volley in Layers placement. 1 is a single exact layer (the default, identical to On Outline). Must be in [1, 64].

How bullets are dealt across layers: Interleaved (bullet i rides layer i % count, winding survives), Sequential (fills contiguous chunks starting from [member helper_outline_layer_start_offset], so small volleys still read as the base shape with offset 0), Outer First (sequential from the outermost ring inward) or Ping Pong (waves 0..last..0, pairs with spin). Layers placement only.
Which side of the base outline extra layers grow toward: Outward (each ring bigger), Inward (rings crowd toward the center), or Both (alternating bigger/smaller). Layers placement only.
Fractional growth per layer: each extra ring rescales the shape about the loop center (0.2 = 20% bigger per layer outward). Must be finite in (0, 8]. Layers placement only.

Which layer Sequential-family filling starts from (wraps around, so 1 starts on the second ring and the outline fills last). 0 starts on the outline. Only shown — and only consumed — in Layers placement with Sequential or Outer First fill; Interleaved and Ping Pong ignore it. Must be 0 or more.
Ring-size progression: Linear steps evenly, Exponential compounds ((1 + step)^L, mirrored reciprocally inward). A non-empty [member helper_outline_layer_scales] overrides both. Layers placement only.

Explicit per-layer scales, entry L % size (e.g. [1.0, 1.5, 1.6] for a tight outer pair). Empty means the formula above. Each entry must be finite in [0.05, 64], at most 64 entries. Layers placement only.
Slot rotation per successive layered ring (0 = off, negatives wrap): stacked rings interleave angularly instead of sitting in spokes. Layer 0 is never twisted. Layers placement only.

Max bullets kept per extra layer (0 = unlimited): overflow is dropped, first-kept in bullet order, so the volley may shrink below helper_bullets_amount. Layer 0 is never capped. Layers placement only.
Rotates which closed-loop slot becomes bullet 0 (wraps both ways). On-outline and layers layouts only.
Where a fixed Path2D run sits when shorter than the curve: Path Start, Centered, or Path End (Fixed Spacing mode only). helper_path2d_start_offset shifts on top of this.

Include the last-to-first stretch when measuring a Path2D curve, so spacing wraps on loop paths. Curves already drawn as loops need nothing extra (no double segment is added); two-point outlines always stay open.

How Path2D bullets are placed: Fixed Spacing lays helper_bullets_amount bullets helper_path2d_spacing apart (helper_path2d_anchor/overflow decide placement when the run is shorter/longer than the curve), Spread Evenly covers the whole curve length (both endpoints included on open paths; seamless ring without a duplicated seam bullet on closed loops).
Which direction Path2D bullets face: Along Path (+X with travel, the tangent), Normal +90, or Normal -90. helper_path2d_facing_offset_deg applies on top.
Extra facing twist in degrees on top of the Path2D facing. Must be finite.

What happens when a fixed Path2D run does not fit (run longer than the curve, or shifted past its ends): Clamp piles extras at the end, Wrap continues from the start, Auto Fit scales spacing down so the run fits exactly (Fixed Spacing mode only).

Path2D node to live-sample bullet positions from (baked curve points, re-resolved every volley, ObjectDB-guarded, expressed in the generator space). Bullets sit exactly on the curve per helper_path2d_distribution; empty means no outline.
Walk the Path2D curve end to start (exact mirror: bullet 0 lands on the curve end). Along Path facing flips with it.

Which frame the Path2D curve is drawn in. Follow Generator (default) copies the curve shape onto the generator with its bounding-box center reset to the origin: only the shape matters, the node's own transform and wherever the curve was drawn are ignored (moving/rotating the Path2D node does nothing), like every other pattern. At Path2D Node keeps the legacy pose: the volley materializes where the node sits in the world. Flip back to this if an existing scene relied on the old default. When the path is a child of the generator at origin, both modes coincide.
Offset in pixels between consecutive Path2D bullets (Fixed Spacing mode only). Must be finite and greater than 0.

Distance in pixels along the Path2D curve where layout starts (Fixed: first-bullet position on top of the anchor; Spread Evenly: phase-rotates a loop, or pushes an open run toward the end, clamped). Must be finite and 0 or more.
Polygon bullets face outward; off faces inward.
Extra facing twist in degrees on top of the polygon normal. Must be finite.
Polygon corner radius in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Polygon base rotation in radians. Must be finite.
Polygon corner count (true perimeter, not the Star Polygon scatter mode). Must be 3 or more.
Width of the rain band in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Direction the rain falls (need not be normalized). Must be finite and non-zero.
Row spacing of the layered sheets. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Random offset per slot in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Seed for rain jitter only. 0 is non-deterministic, otherwise every volley lands identically. Does nothing while [member helper_rain_jitter] is 0. Only shown for the Rain pattern.
Rectangle bullets face outward; off faces inward.
Extra facing twist in degrees on top of the rectangle normal. Must be finite.
Rectangle perimeter size in pixels, centered on the generator. Must be finite with sides 0 or more.
Ring length in radians. Full circle by default.
Face bullets away from the center. Off faces them inward.
Twists every ring facing by this many degrees.
Ring radius around the generator.
Give each ring bullet a random facing.
Seed for ring random rotation only. 0 is non-deterministic, otherwise every volley lands identically. Does nothing while [member helper_ring_random_rotation] is off. Only shown for the Ring pattern.
Rotate the ring with the generator.
Angle in radians where the ring starts.
Squashes the ring into an ellipse. 1.0 is a circle.
Rotates the whole rose in radians. Must be finite.
Face along the petal axis away from the center. Off faces inward.
Extra facing twist in degrees. Must be finite.
Lobe pinch: 1.0 is the exact rose, 0 is round, higher is tighter. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Rose lobes (rhodonea k). Must be 2 or more. Recipe: Rose + phase_step_per_bullet + angular wobble = blossom finale.
Rose radius in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Sector width in radians around [member helper_scatter_direction]. TAU or more is a full circle; narrow it (with a direction) for cones of fire. Must be finite and above 0.
Outer radius of the burst disc in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more. Use it for explosions, boss deaths and pops: wide radius with many bullets reads as a blast, small radius as a pop.
Center of the scatter sector. Only matters when [member helper_scatter_arc] is below TAU. Must be finite and non-zero. Use it for directional blasts and shotgun fans.
Bullet facing: 0 outward (explosions), 1 random (shotgun spray), 2 inward (implosions).

Random twist on each outward/inward facing in radians (ignored by random facing, which is already random). Must be finite and 0 or more. Small values keep the radial look, large values dissolve it into spray.

Inner radius of the burst annulus in pixels. 0 is a full disc; above 0 the center stays empty for explosion rings. Clamped to [member helper_scatter_burst_radius] at generation, so set order never matters.

Scatter-only seed: 0 is non-deterministic, otherwise every volley lands identically (combine with spin for rotating replays). Drives burst positions, sector angles and random facings of this pattern only.
Slot indexes to drop from any helper layout (dodge doors, bullet text). Out-of-range entries are ignored with a single warning. Applied after spin/scale so indexes match the preview.
Angle step in radians per spiral bullet.
Spiral facing, same values as [enum BulletFactory2D.SpiralFacingMode].
Twists every spiral facing by this many degrees.
Radius growth per spiral bullet.
Rotate the spiral with the generator.
Radius of the first spiral bullet.
Square bullets face outward; off faces inward.
Extra facing twist in degrees on top of the square normal. Must be finite.
Square perimeter side length in pixels, centered on the generator. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Base rotation of the star in radians.
Whether slots face away from the marker.
Extra facing twist in degrees.
Inner vertex radius. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Outer vertex radius. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Star points (alternating outer/inner vertices). Must be 2 or more.
Rotates the whole star. Must be finite.
Face away from the marker. Off faces the marker.
Twists every star facing. Must be finite.
Star radius in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Star sharpness: 0 is an even ring, higher pulls density toward the vertices. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Star vertices. Must be 3 or more.
Trapezoid bottom base width in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Trapezoid top base width in pixels (0 degrades to a triangle). Must be finite and 0 or more.
Trapezoid bullets face outward; off faces inward.
Extra facing twist in degrees on top of the trapezoid normal. Must be finite.
Trapezoid height in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Trapezoid base rotation in radians. Must be finite.
Triangle bullets face outward; off faces inward.
Extra facing twist in degrees on top of the triangle normal. Must be finite.
Triangle base rotation in radians. Must be finite.
Equilateral circumradius / isosceles base width / right X leg in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Isosceles height / right Y leg in pixels (unused by Equilateral). Must be finite and 0 or more.

Triangle kind: Equilateral (circumradius helper_triangle_size_a), Isosceles (base helper_triangle_size_a + height helper_triangle_size_b, apex up), Right (legs helper_triangle_size_a along X and helper_triangle_size_b along Y, recentered). All centered on the generator.
Horizontal spacing in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Curtain columns. Must be 1 or more.
Extra facing twist in degrees. Must be finite.
Random offset per slot in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Seed for waterfall jitter only. 0 is non-deterministic, otherwise every volley lands identically. Does nothing while [member helper_waterfall_jitter] is 0. Only shown for the Waterfall pattern.
Fall direction (need not be normalized). Must be finite and non-zero.
Row spacing in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Curtain rows. Must be 1 or more.
Per-row stagger factor. Must be finite.
Sine amplitude in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Row axis (need not be normalized). Must be finite and non-zero.
Whether slots face along the wave tangent.
Extra facing twist in degrees.
Wave count across the row. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Snake row width in pixels. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Advances per-bullet queues when a target is reached. Only used in Per Bullet mode.
Parent whose Node2D children are chased for the Node Children source. Required: empty or invalid paths fly without homing.
Includes grandchildren and deeper descendants for the Node Children source.
Prints resolved target count and first target per homing volley. Use it when bullets fly straight unexpectedly.
Seconds of straight flight before volley steering starts (classic aimed-then-homing). 0 steers immediately. Must be finite and 0 or more.
A target counts as reached inside this distance. Predictive, so fast bullets still trigger.
Seconds of steering before volleys fly straight (lets fast players escape). 0 is infinite. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Master switch: every volley chases the configured targets. Off means volleys fly exactly as the spawn data says.
Extra allow-list on top of any source: only targets also in this group are kept. Empty means no filtering.

Fire cone in degrees around the spawner facing (homing only): a volley with resolved targets but none inside half this angle is skipped before spawning (volley_skipped "outside_fire_arc"). Empty resolutions still fire plain volleys; the mouse source never resolves, so the cone ignores it. 0 is omnidirectional. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Position chased per volley for the Global Position source. Must be finite.
Volley steering pauses while the bullet is farther than this from its target. 0 is unlimited. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Detection radius around the spawner for the node group, node name, and node children sources. 0 is unlimited.

How many targets enter the queue. 1 is classic single-target homing. Only the node group, node name, and node children sources use it. Valid range is 1-10000; each homing queue caps at 256 entries, so larger resolutions are clamped to 256 per queue.
0 shares one target queue across the whole volley, 1 gives every bullet its own queue (same targets each).
Polled group for the Node Group source. Only Node2D members can be chased, the rest are skipped.
Name pattern chased for the Node Name source. The whole scene is scanned, so dynamically spawned enemies are found with no group setup. The spawner itself never matches.
Compares node names strictly. Off (default) matches "Player" against "PlAyEr".
How the node name source compares names: exact, contains, starts with, or ends with.
Fans smoothing out per bullet: bullet i steers with start + step times i.
Seconds between automatic retarget passes. Must be above zero.
0 leaves flying volleys alone, On Interval re-resolves and replaces their queues every interval. On by default so group, name, and children tracking stays live as members spawn and die.
Staggers the retarget phase so many spawners do not scene-scan on the same tick. The period stays homing_retarget_interval_sec. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Retargeting re-aims every tracked live volley. Turn off to re-aim only the newest volley, letting older ones fly at whatever they chased last.
Max turn rate in radians per second. 0 snaps instantly.
Per-bullet smoothing of the first bullet.
Per-bullet smoothing growth per bullet. May be negative, results clamp at 0.
Lets homing steer the bullet facing. Turn off only when a movement pattern, rotation data, or orbiting texture mode already owns the facing, otherwise homing steers nothing.
Node chased per volley for the Node Path source. Must point at a live Node2D, otherwise the volley flies without homing.
Which detected nodes become targets: nearest to the spawner, random, tree order, round robin across volleys, or dealt across bullets (Per Bullet mode only).

Where volley targets come from: a node group, the mouse cursor, a global position snapshot, a node path, a node name, or a node's children. Each source shows its own settings, like the pattern_source helper patterns do.
Seconds between target position refreshes. 0 refreshes every tick.

Soft live-bullet fuse: 0 is unlimited, otherwise firing pauses (volley_skipped "over_budget") while this spawner's live bullets (homing AND plain volleys, counted via the factory) reach this count. Counts actual spawned bullets, so gap-carving modes (Corridor gap, Ellipse Wall, skip indices) consume less budget than helper_bullets_amount. The census is O(factory volleys) per trigger pull: fine for a handful of budgeted spawners, prefer fewer budgeted spawners (or staggered intervals) past ~100 spawners.

Auto-shooting stops after this many volleys. -1 is infinite, 0 disables auto-shooting ([method shoot_once] still works). Lowering the cap below the fired count emits [signal shooting_stopped] (raising it back emits [signal shooting_started]); [signal shooting_finished] fires once from the volley that trips the cap, so a volley_fired handler that lowers the cap never double-fires it. Untouched by [method fire_n_volleys].

Orbit direction. DontMove means escort: bullets hold a fixed slot on the ring and follow the target without circling. OrbitRandom rolls OrbitLeft or OrbitRight per bullet when the volley spawns (never DontMove); live volleys keep their rolled direction on retarget passes, so switching to OrbitRandom mid-flight only affects new volleys.
Bullets ring their homing target once they arrive. Needs [member homing_enabled]: orbiting without a homing target does nothing.

Deadzone radius in pixels, used only when [member orbiting_follow_mode] is FollowDeadzone. The ring center stays pinned while the target moves within this distance of the lock point, then re-pins to the target.

How the locked ring follows a moving target. FollowTarget tracks the target 1:1. FollowDeadzone pins the ring center until the target walks farther than [member orbiting_follow_deadzone] from it, absorbing jitter. Anchored freezes the ring where it locked and ignores target motion entirely.

What drops the orbit lock. RelockAlways re-acquires the radius on every retarget. StayLocked never unlocks on retarget or empty queues: once locked, bullets keep their angle and center until you explicitly disable orbiting, clear targets, or the target is freed. RelockOnTargetChange unlocks only when the front target is a different target than the one the bullet locked onto, so the same moving Node2D never breaks the ring. For a bodyguard ring on a moving Node2D use StayLocked with FollowTarget (or FollowDeadzone) and a stationary retarget mode.
Orbit ring radius in pixels. Must be at least 0.01.
Fans the radius out per bullet: bullet i orbits with start + step times i (concentric shells).
Orbit radius of the first bullet in linear mode.
Orbit radius growth per bullet in linear mode. May be negative, results clamp at 0.01.

When on, locked OrbitLeft/OrbitRight bullets translate 1:1 with the target and keep circling, exactly like DontMove escorts. When off, locked bullets chase the ring clamped to speed times delta and trail behind fast targets.
How bullet textures face while physically orbiting.

Scales the whole pattern around the generator (positions and bullet size grow together). 1.0 keeps it as is, 0 collapses it onto the generator, negatives mirror it. Compose with transforms_scale for big-layout + big-bullet looks.

Seed for homing random-target selection ([constant BulletSpawner2D.HOMING_SELECT_RANDOM]) only. 0 is non-deterministic, otherwise picks reproduce. Only shown when that selection is active. Does not affect steering, smoothing, retargeting or any bullet pattern.

Seed for [member reload_jitter_sec] only. 0 is non-deterministic, otherwise the jitter sequence reproduces (seed + volleys fired, so volleys still vary per shot). Does nothing while [member reload_jitter_sec] is 0. Does not affect any bullet pattern or homing pick.

Where volley transforms come from: children markers (0), this generator itself (1), or one of 31 procedural helper patterns (2-32: Grid, Ring, Fan, Spiral, Line, Aimed, Flower, Ellipse, Rain, Scatter, Star Polygon, Multi Spiral, Cross, Star, Heart, Wave, Waterfall, Lattice, Rose, Counter Spiral, Corridor, Lissajous, Custom, Circle, Rectangle, Square, Polygon, Path2D, Triangle, Trapezoid, Diamond). Order in the inspector groups sources, basic shapes, ornamental loops, then generators. Only the active pattern's options show in the inspector. Pipeline per volley: generate (with outline placement/fill/layers for the loop shapes), then spin, then pattern/local scale, then helper_skip_indices carving (so skip indexes match the preview). Corridor, Ellipse Wall and outline Fill Inside modes return fewer transforms than helper_bullets_amount.
Preview arrow color.
Gap in pixels between dot edge and arrow tail.
Preview arrow head length in pixels.
Preview arrow head width in pixels.
Preview arrow length in pixels (multiplied by pattern_scale and transforms_scale, so glyphs stay proportional to the layout).
Preview arrow shaft width in pixels.
Preview dot color.
Preview dot radius in pixels (multiplied by pattern_scale and transforms_scale, so glyphs stay proportional to the layout).
Emphasis color for bullet 0 in the preview (pattern start: anchor, reverse, loop seam). Drawn bigger on top of the regular dot.

Track underlay color: the shape/loop/curve bullets ride on, drawn as segments under the dots so sparse volleys still show the whole track. Distinct from dots, arrows and the first-bullet marker by default.

Extra outline-layer ring color (Layers placement only): one yellow closed ring per ring beyond the base outline, drawn under the dots with the same width as the base track and never antialiased. Same alpha as the base track by default. Empty unless layers are active (count above 1 with valid spacing).
Track underlay line width in pixels (multiplied by nothing: absolute screen-ish size). 0 hides the track. Must be finite and 0 or more.

Reload jitter in seconds: each auto volley waits shoot_interval_sec +/- uniform jitter (seeded by [member reload_jitter_seed], floored at 0.001s so fast intervals keep working with jitter on). 0 is exact. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Advances the shared queue when a target is reached. Only used in Shared mode.
Delay before the first volley after (re)arming.

Seconds between automatic volleys. Must be above zero. Runs on an accumulator: overshoot carries over so the average rate is exact at any value (fast intervals repay every due volley in the same tick, up to 8 pulls; hitch backlogs beyond that resync instead of bursting).
Master switch for automatic shooting. [method shoot_once] works regardless.
Shows one dot and facing arrow per bullet in the editor. Follows the generator live. Never saved to the scene.
Also shows the preview while the game runs. Off by default.
Bullet data for each volley. Duplicated per volley, so sharing one resource is safe.

Flat global offset added to every bullet right after spawn (muzzle offsets, spawn-then-nudge). Zero disables the pass. Applied through the engine teleport path, so shapes, attachments, and interpolation stay in sync. Must be finite.
How far the pattern swings each way in oscillate mode.
Rotates each volley around the generator at runtime. Editor preview stays still.
Swings per second in oscillate mode.
0 rotates forever, 1 swings back and forth (see amplitude and frequency).
Spin speed in continuous mode. Positive is clockwise.
Warn before firing: emits volley_telegraphed with the current aim, then fires after telegraph_sec. Transforms re-collect at fire time.
Warning time before the volley fires. Must be finite and 0 or more.
Node patterns are built on. Empty means this spawner. Point it at another Node2D to move children markers, helper shapes, spin pivot, scale center, and the preview there.

Per-bullet size scale: multiplies each spawn transform's local basis (texture size) without moving its position. 1.0 keeps sizes as generated, 0 hides bullets in place, negatives mirror them. Must be finite.

signal.name: area_entered
signal.description: Fired when one of this spawner's bullets enters an area.

signal.name: body_entered
signal.description: Fired when one of this spawner's bullets hits a body.

signal.name: burst_finished
signal.description: Fired when the last shot of a burst chain fires.

signal.name: burst_shot_fired
signal.description: Fired for every shot inside a burst chain, with the 1-based shot number and whether this shot fired mirrored (alternate-mirror mode).

signal.name: homing_targets_resolved
signal.description: Fired per volley with the resolved targets (Node2D or Vector2 entries). Empty for the Mouse source and for volleys that found nothing.

signal.name: life_time_over
signal.description: Fired when this spawner's bullets expire. Needs the lifetime signal enabled in the bullet data.

signal.name: pattern_list_finished
signal.description: Fired when a sequential pattern-list queue drains (the last entry's source stays active as the new phase). Simultaneous lists do not emit this - they return the fired count from [method spawn_pattern_list] directly.

signal.name: pre_shoot
signal.description: Last-chance hook fired after the volley instance is stamped but before homing/orbiting is configured and before volley_fired. Handlers may tweak the duplicated volley data (speed ramp, difficulty scale). Same handler contract as volley_fired: never call shoot_once from here (use shoot_once_deferred).

signal.name: retarget_applied
signal.description: Fired after an automatic interval retarget pass that touched at least one volley. HUD and wave logic can observe tracking health from this.

signal.name: shooting_finished
signal.description: Fired when the volley counter reaches [member max_volleys].

signal.name: shooting_started
signal.description: Fired when automatic shooting turns on.

signal.name: shooting_stopped
signal.description: Fired when automatic shooting turns off via [member shooting_enabled].

signal.name: volley_bullet_homing_target_reached
signal.description: Forwarded from the volley instance when one of its bullets reaches its homing target. Target is null for position and mouse targets, and for freed nodes. Note: pool reuse clears all handlers on the instance, so connect here on the spawner instead of on volley instances directly.

signal.name: volley_fired
signal.description: Fired for every volley, with a 1-based counter.

signal.name: volley_homing_configured
signal.description: Fired for every homing/orbiting volley right after it is configured, before [signal volley_fired]. Only fires when homing or orbiting is enabled.

signal.name: volley_skipped
signal.description: Fired when a volley is skipped without spawning: "no_transforms" (empty pattern) or "over_budget" (max_live_bullets fuse). Games can fall back on these instead of log-diving.

signal.name: volley_telegraphed
signal.description: Fired when a telegraph warning starts, with a snapshot of the current aim (advisory: the actual fire re-collects transforms). Draw warning lines, flash markers, play the cue.

Honeycomb lattice from the generator.
Exact rhodonea rose bloom from the generator (petal-storm / blossom-finale flowers).
Twin counter-rotating galaxy arms from the generator (odd arms mirror when enabled).

Dense wall perpendicular to the aim axis with a carved center dodge door. Returns at most helper_bullets_amount slots (the gap shrinks the array like Ellipse Wall). Prefers the aimed target when one is assigned, else helper_corridor_aim_direction.
Figure-8 / weave curtain from the generator (crossing rows with readable doors).

Hand-placed transforms: every entry of helper_custom_transforms spawns exactly one bullet where stored (generator-local), facing per helper_custom_facing, in array order (helper_custom_reverse/slot_offset reorder it). The count comes from the array; helper_bullets_amount is ignored. Apply TERRAIN_CREST once for a starter crest line.
Exact circle loop outline from the generator (radius + outward flip + offset).
Rectangle perimeter walk centered on the generator (size + outward flip + offset).
Square perimeter walk centered on the generator (single side length + outward flip + offset).
True polygon perimeter (vertices/radius/rotation + outward flip + offset). Distinct from Star Polygon mode, which is vertex-biased scatter.

Live Path2D curve layout (baked points, re-sampled every volley, generator-local). Bullets sit exactly on the curve per helper_path2d_distribution (Fixed Spacing default 32px, or Even over the whole length), facing tangent-first per helper_path2d_facing (Along Path default, Normal +90/-90 across it).

Triangle perimeter (equilateral/isosceles/right via helper_triangle_type), slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). Full outline-layout support (on outline, concentric layers, interior fill).
Isosceles trapezoid perimeter, slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). Full outline-layout support.
Diamond (rhombus) perimeter from its diagonals, slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). Full outline-layout support.
Path2D bullets are laid helper_path2d_spacing apart.
Path2D bullets spread evenly over the whole curve length.
Oversized Path2D runs pile extras at the curve end.
Oversized Path2D runs wrap around from the curve start.
Oversized Path2D runs shrink spacing so every bullet fits.
Short Path2D runs hug the curve start.
Short Path2D runs center on the curve.
Short Path2D runs hug the curve end.
Path2D bullets face along travel (+X with the curve tangent).
Path2D bullets follow the generator: baked curve points are generator-local offsets.
Path2D bullets appear where the Path2D node sits in the world (legacy behavior).
Path2D bullets face 90 degrees clockwise from travel.
Path2D bullets face 90 degrees counter-clockwise from travel.
Spins forever at [member spin_speed_deg_per_sec].
Swings back and forth using amplitude and frequency.
